purpose: Prevent result-adaptive choice of Research A2 robustness directions while keeping A2 numerics subject to implementation and development power review.

shared_rules.information_symmetry: all arms receive identical raw state, action, train rows, supplied graph, and test rows
shared_rules.primary_effect_orientation: generic minus typed composition NLL and typed minus generic exact recovery
shared_rules.confirmatory_independence: A2 uses a new root seed and cannot alter or repair the A1 estimand
shared_rules.sesoi_source: A1 endpoint-specific SESOI unless A2 development establishes a stricter value before A2 freeze

candidate_width_axis.nuisance_feature_rule: deterministic observable modular functions frozen before A2 seed generation
candidate_width_axis.claim_boundary: tests search-width sensitivity, not representational superiority

training_noise_axis.mathematical_boundary: all levels remain below 6/7, where the true center ceases to be the unique mode
training_noise_axis.claim_boundary: tests degradation as the q-ary mode gap closes

conditions: typed-misspecified fourth-family generator included only in the generic dictionary
generic-misspecified generator family retained by typed search but removed from the generic dictionary
misspecification_axis.claim_boundary: scope and falsification audit only; cannot rescue an A1 or A2 efficiency failure

program_stopping_rule: If A1 and the separately frozen A2 candidate-width and training-noise axes show no joint SESOI-qualified advantage, stop predictive-efficiency development and do not begin turnover or perception studies. Continue Research D because its diagnostic estimand is independent.
required_before_A2_freeze: exact nuisance feature library and collision audit
explicit multiplicity members for each axis
source freeze and public seed commitment
